status: retrospective clarification of observed execution provenance
authoritative_loaded_project_source: The quality process imported its project modules from the source tree identified by the initial quality protocol. It remained running and did not reload those modules during subsequent working-tree edits.
dynamic_disk_metadata: Training provenance.code_revision/code_files and evaluation metadata.evaluation_code were observed later from the working tree/Git. They remain preserved unchanged and describe source files on disk at observation time, not a second import of edited code.
training_scope: The training algorithm, prompts, frozen dataset and fixed training configuration were unchanged. Later gateway, serving-policy and audit edits were not executed by the already-imported quality backend. External torch/transformers/peft dependencies remained in the pinned isolated environment.
quality_decoding: See quality-decoding-addendum.json: all three alternatives used historical greedy repetition penalty 1.1 and publisher EOS settings; serving benchmarks use a distinct explicit policy.
snapshot_integrity: Every preserved source file is raw git-show bytes at the exact recorded immutable startup revision. This reconstruction was performed after startup and does not pretend to be a contemporaneous on-disk capture.
future_runs: The current experiment script captures raw source bytes before generation and refuses uncommitted source/scripts at startup. Use a new output directory and the committed updated script.
